title.en: Environmental Protection and Management (Ozone Depleting Substances) Regulations

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Environmental Protection and Management (Ozone Depleting Substances) Regulations.

heading.en: Prohibition on importation from and exportation to certain countries

text.en: 4. Any person who contravenes regulation 3 shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $50,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 2 years or to both and, in the case of a continuing offence, to a further fine not exceeding $2,000 for every day or part thereof during which the offence continues after conviction.
